received a response several weeks after Dr Jacobs wrote an email that was unconcerned with the majority of what I had to say. I suffer from suicidal thoughts every day, I need support with various health issues, largely relating to sinuses and head pain. This has affected my oral health. I have dyspraxia which was diagnosed through the education system, I have had autism diagnosed by CAMHS as a teenager. He did one referral to the learning disabilities service, who randomly claimed I was ineligible, Dr Jacobs words 'they weren't much more helpful' (followed by laughing), who then said he couldn't do any more. He won't talk to me about anti-depressants in a way which is safe or I feel confident taking them. I am not refusing them, I never have and that's another problem - Dr Jacobs will refer to his records, seems to understand that blood tests etc. are not going to be accurate over a certain period of time, but will refer to what he thinks someone else has said in regards to my feelings on a topic.

To that end, I posted a previous review where I claimed he had prescribed me X. Because of dyspraxia and how badly it affects me, I need to have prescription notes etc. Everything written down. Certainly have a medication mentioned more than once. I believe I became confused because he's basically said nothing about them and remembered it started with a V and had an X in it. I have no interest in taking an experimental class of drug and would like to discuss it. If Dr Jacobs feels he can't then he's free to refer me back to Dr Belderbos, however, I am not going to request a psychiatrist's time as I'M NOT A DOCTOR AND HAVE NO FUCKING IDEA IF I SHOULD OR NOT. When he prescribed them, he did no blood check and no advice for how or when I should take them. I have a learning difficulty that affects those sorts of 'daily' tasks. This man won't actually try and get me help. He'd rather see me die. He doesn't come across as trustworthy and he doesn't listen. I really have tried to give him the benefit of the doubt but he's another GP who really has lost sight of what it means to be a professional and does his job by doing what he thinks will placate people rather than think about what might actually be helpful to them.

I haven't had a smear test ever. I'm 33. I am losing my hearing because of ear wax impaction and would like to know what I should do before I follow the advice of, say, a pharmacist considering how long it's been going on for (almost a decade) and acknowledgement that I can't use a phone.",null,[0,233]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/12845239388440315355/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjEwUlZaclZsSmxXSEI0WVdwS2NsZ3diRXRTTUhSd1l6SktSMkV6WXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210RVZrVlJlWHB4YWpKclgwbEtSMHRwYzJKR2EzYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xa59a2a9e8e2acac8!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmtEVkVReXpxajJrX0lKR0tpc2JGa3c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT210RVZrVlJlWHB4YWpKclgwbEtSMHRwYzJKR2EzYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjxrYv747KTAxVSRoQGHQxlJpsQoykICigB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwjxrYv747KTAxVSRoQGHQxlJpsQ0pMFCAgoAg"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBeHBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVI2UzNkTk1GOWZSV2hEWVhwc04wbDRXbGx6TjNwWGFsSnhRVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSWjBOYVVFMXlRWHBSV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s5U2JYUnRRbVJHYkZOM1ZEZ3pjR3hqUkRKR2VYYxAB",["0x0:0xa59a2a9e8e2acac8",null,1763741441644134,1763741441644134,[null,null,["https:/
